## 2. Core Service Offerings & Expertise

### A. SaaS Product & UI/UX Design
- Comprehensive user research, customer journey mapping, and wireframing.
- Multi-tier SaaS dashboards, data visualization, and complex filter states.
- Micro-interactions, states (empty, loading, error, hover, active), and accessibility standards (WCAG AA).

### B. Scalable Figma Design Systems
- Component architecture, variants, auto-layout, and tokenized design systems.
- Synchronized color tokens, typography scales, spacing grids, and elevation layers.
- Seamless developer handoff documentation for React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.

### C. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Landing Pages
- Value proposition framing, above-the-fold engagement architecture, and lead-capture UX.
- Frictionless checkout and inquiry funnels.
- Visual hierarchy engineered for maximum retention and user action.

### D. Creative Direction & Motion Production
- High-retention video editing and pacing for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok.
- Motion graphics, kinetic typography, and audio design.
- Organic video SEO, metadata optimization, and audience retention engineering.
